title: A compliance record's fields, Certificate number and attachment
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia of "Aacrest Works") enrolled on a schedule that has a compliance service "CVIP" (Term 12 months), seeded with the standard steps.
  3. Open the asset page; the asset card is on the left and its Compliance section sits below Contact.
  4. Have ready: a 1 MB PDF, a PNG image, a Word (.docx) file and a 12 MB PDF.
custom_steps:
1. Click + Add record and read the fields, their labels and their widths.
  2. Read the number field's label; save a record with it left empty (Term 12 months, Start date 14 Oct 2025).
  3. Edit the record: attach the 1 MB PDF and save; then attach the PNG with Replace; then Remove it.
  4. Try to attach the .docx file, then the 12 MB PDF.
  5. Hover the (i) beside Type.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The form has Type, Term, Start date, End date, Certificate number and one attachment; each field is half or full width.
  • The number field is labelled "Certificate number"; it is always shown and the record saves with it empty.
  • The PDF attaches; Replace swaps it for the PNG (the record keeps only one file); Remove clears it.
  • The .docx file and the 12 MB PDF are both refused.
  • On the design the Type (i) reads "The compliance inspection this record belongs to."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S8 (The number and the file; S8-R2 to S8-R4, S8-R6, S8-R9); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 5.2 API contract, A20; Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard K4; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R2: “A record will carry type, term, Start date, End date, an optional certificate number and one optional attachment”
  • S8-R6: “Field widths will follow one scale, half or full”
  • S8-R3: “The number field is labelled Certificate number”
  • S8-R4: “The number field is optional but always present”
  • S8-R9: “It can be replaced or removed; replacing it replaces the record's only attachment”
  • S8-R9: “A record carries one optional file: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB”
  • Plan 1 §5.2 A20: “400 for a wrong mime type or a file over 10 MB”
  • Design board, artboard K4: “PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB”
  • Design board, artboard K4 (Type (i)): “The compliance inspection this record belongs to.”
